pages.summary: Pansy descubre el pasillo del café y encuentra en Jane una aliada para elegir las cápsulas.

panels.scene: Wide aisle with a full wall of tastefully colored coffee capsule boxes. Pansy has stopped in delighted concentration. Hermione walks ahead of her a few steps with Jane and the shopping cart, Zephyr near Pansy.
panels.caption: La lista dejó de importar al llegar al pasillo del café.

panels.scene: Pansy takes one pale brown box from the shelf. It reads exactly «Pan de jengibre» in simple short type. Robin watches from his own cream canopy.
dialogue: Pansy: Esta tiene notas de pan de jengibre.

panels.scene: Hermione has returned with her hands relaxed on the shopping cart's handle. She raises an amused eyebrow toward Pansy. Jane is just beyond the frame.
dialogue: Hermione: Ya tenemos café en casa.

panels.scene: Pansy holding one box in her left hand and a second in the crook of the other arm, with a small knowing smile. A coherent aisle, no extra boxes in her hands.
dialogue: Pansy: Ninguna cápsula sabe a pan de jengibre.

panels.scene: Jane gently places a modest hazelnut box into the cart, label exactly «Avellana». Hermione turns to her mother. One safe Robin and Pansy in background. Frame Jane at LEFT for the first balloon, Hermione at RIGHT for the reply, their faces unobstructed.
dialogue: Jane: La de avellana es buena.
Hermione: ¡Mamá!

panels.scene: Rear three-quarter view of the trio moving past the long coffee aisle. Vegetables, bread and several distinct coffee boxes sit in the ordinary grocery cart. Robin smiles from his pram.
dialogue: Pansy: Tu madre posee un criterio excelente.

pages.summary: Pansy y Robin quedan fascinados con los televisores. Hermione recibe dos votos en contra.

panels.scene: Pansy near the electronics aisle gently lifts a single tiny Robin from the parked cream pram with both arms. Jane stands by with groceries and Hermione approaches in the distance.
panels.caption: Al fondo del supermercado empezaba la electrónica.

panels.scene: Wide perspective of a wall of generic flat televisions showing colorful landscapes, weather and sports-like silhouettes. From behind, Pansy cradles Robin, separated from the screens by a normal aisle.
dialogue: Pansy: Sí, yo también lo veo.

panels.scene: Close Pansy’s astonished green eyes and Robin's face in her arms. Both look toward a blue cartoon elephant on just one screen. Robin raises one small natural hand.
dialogue: Pansy: Voy a instalar uno en nuestra habitación.

panels.scene: Hermione stops by the shopping cart, smiling but skeptical. Pansy and Robin turn slightly toward her.
dialogue: Hermione: Los aparatos muggles no funcionan bien en Hogwarts.

panels.scene: Pansy glances back at the televisions with an amused smile, still supporting Robin. Hermione in plum coat and Jane behind the cart. No extra characters.
dialogue: Pansy: Para eso está la bruja más brillante de nuestra generación.

panels.scene: Close Robin points at the blue elephant while Pansy holds him, Hermione laughs near them, clear everyday gestures. Frame Hermione at LEFT for the first balloon, Pansy at RIGHT for the reply, their faces unobstructed.
dialogue: Hermione: No pienso pasar las noches viendo animales de colores.
Pansy: Dos votos contra uno.

pages.summary: Pansy se interesa por una licuadora. Robin encuentra un oso que canta cuando se enciende su estrella.

panels.scene: At the demonstration counter, an employee in a plain blue apron stands behind a closed transparent blender pitcher of fruit. Pansy approaches, with Robin securely in the Zephyr, Hermione and Jane nearby.
panels.caption: El siguiente descubrimiento fue la licuadora.

panels.scene: Pansy looks at the unbranded blender with great concentration. Hermione leans on the cart handle, glass pitcher safely closed and countertop high above the pram. Frame Pansy at LEFT for the first balloon, Hermione at RIGHT for the reply, their faces unobstructed.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Qué hace?
Hermione: Batidos.

panels.scene: Jane gives Pansy a small sample cup across the clean counter. Hermione smiles and Robin stays comfortable in his stroller, no food in his hands. Frame Pansy at LEFT for the first balloon, Jane at RIGHT for the reply, their faces unobstructed.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Tenemos una en casa?
Jane: Sí.

panels.scene: A few minutes later, at the edge of the toy aisle, Jane lifts Robin from the parked Zephyr with two clear hands and supports him upright. His blue cardigan, human face and brown curls are unchanged.
panels.caption: Una canción suave llamó la atención de Robin.

panels.scene: Close shelf with several ordinary plush bears. One small tawny teddy has a sewn yellow star on its belly, emitting a gentle light. Robin reaches one little hand from Jane's arms in the foreground.
dialogue: Jane: ¿Qué ocurre, cariño?

panels.scene: Jane holds Robin and offers the small cloth bear, his green eyes and small bare hands visible as he hugs it. Hermione stands beside Pansy.
dialogue: Jane: Su abuela se lo va a regalar por Navidad.

pages.summary: Robin conserva su oso mientras pagan. En el estacionamiento, Jane sorprende a Pansy con una pregunta.

panels.scene: At checkout the three queue with one cart. Jane keeps Robin in her arms and he hugs the bear. The empty Zephyr with cream hood is parked aside, distinct from the shopping cart.
panels.caption: Robin no soltó su oso al llegar a la caja.

panels.scene: A cashier moves a plain coffee box past the fixed barcode reader on the conveyor. Pansy leans slightly toward Hermione, fascinated. Keep safe ordinary checkout, no readable prices or numbers. Frame Pansy at LEFT for the first balloon, Hermione at RIGHT for the reply, their faces unobstructed.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Cómo sabe cuánto cuesta?
Hermione: Por el código de barras.

panels.scene: The cashier uses a small hand scanner near the tag on the toy bear, angled away from Robin's eyes. Jane holds Robin safely. Pansy watches the little toy star glow.
dialogue: Jane: No se lo vamos a quitar, cariño.

panels.scene: Pansy looks at Hermione across the end of the conveyor. She holds a single printed receipt with unreadable fine marks, Hermione smiles without encouraging a new machine. Frame Pansy at LEFT for the first balloon, Hermione at RIGHT for the reply, their faces unobstructed.
dialogue: Pansy: Necesitamos uno de esos lectores.
Hermione: Ni siquiera quiero saber para qué.

panels.scene: Outside supermarket at winter dusk. Pansy and Hermione set paper grocery bags in the open rear cargo area of the same graphite SUV. Jane stands clear of the tailgate in camel coat.
dialogue: Pansy: Las cápsulas van encima.

panels.scene: Jane beside the closed SUV tailgate, holding a single set of keys near her coat pocket. Pansy turns with clear green eyes and quiet surprise by the closed side door. Empty aisle in the parking lot, lamps reflecting in wet paving.
dialogue: Jane: Pansy, ¿te gustaría aprender a conducir?
